# foliate-js (vendored)

Copied from https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js at commit
78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1 (MIT, see LICENSE). zip.js is BSD-3-Clause, fflate MIT.

Only the modules Feeder's Ebooks tab uses are here. PDF support (pdf.js, ~13 MB) is left out, so
`view.js` can't open PDFs. Update by copying the same files from a newer commit; don't edit them.
